hero.title: Robotics will shape tomorrow
hero.desc: Studies reveal that people expect robots to deliver higher precision and reliability compared to human workers.
hero.cta: Explore the innovations of the future

techNews.title: Human–machine synergy
techNews.subtitle: Latest in technology
techNews.desc1: Collaborative robots are designed to support human operators rather than replace them. They take over repetitive or physically demanding tasks such as lifting, overhead assembly, or supplying materials to workstations. This partnership increases efficiency and reduces strain on employees.
techNews.desc2: Discussions around automation often highlight risks to jobs, yet new evidence shows that AI is creating fresh opportunities and hybrid roles where humans and machines work side by side.
techNews.highlight: Automation is transforming industries, not just replacing them.

techInfo.title: Robotics at CES 2021
techInfo.desc: Navigating CES can be overwhelming with countless innovations on display. Focusing on robotics revealed just how diverse and fast‑moving the field has become, from consumer gadgets to industrial solutions.
techInfo.extra: Healthcare robots, delivery drones, and service bots demonstrated how automation is entering everyday life.

service1.title: Automation
service1.desc: The industrial revolution introduced machines that reshaped society. Today, automation continues that legacy by streamlining processes and boosting productivity.

service2.title: Engineering
service2.desc: Advances in engineering allow robots to adapt to complex environments, improving safety and efficiency across industries.

service3.title: Manufacturing
service3.desc: Global manufacturers are investing in robotics to cut costs, increase output, and meet sustainability goals.

techTrends.title: Emerging Tech Trends
techTrends.desc: Flexible production lines and ergonomic support are now possible thanks to automation that was once unimaginable.

testimonials.title: Voices from the field
testimonials.desc: Understanding lunar resources is crucial. Radar and spectroscopy provide clues, but robotic missions can deliver direct evidence without risk to human crews.
testimonials.name: Jane Doe

works.title: AI robots and the evolution of work
works.desc: Global robot numbers are nearing one million, with Japan leading adoption. Decades ago, most robots were confined to car factories. Today, they are spread across diverse industries, performing tasks once thought impossible.
works.extra: Robots are now entering healthcare, agriculture, and education, reshaping how people interact with technology.

perspective.title: Artificial Intelligence & Robotics
perspective.subtitle: Perspectives on AI
perspective.desc: Traditional industries like coal mining are fading as health risks and economic decline push younger generations toward new opportunities. Renewable energy and advanced technologies are creating cleaner, safer jobs and driving progress forward.
perspective.quote: Innovation is the cornerstone of a sustainable and prosperous future.
